statement: The pinned pcble2gamepad Pro compatibility implementation keeps factory stick data through 0x604F, exposes four consecutive 3-byte colour fields at 0x6050..0x605B plus a design byte at 0x605C, and advertises the extended colour setting in its factory configuration. Its source-level regression asserts both the 13-byte colour read and the 25-byte read that overlaps factory-stick data and colour fields. These establish an emulator's behavior and test intent, not retail Pro SPI content, real-device colour defaults, or all-0xFF consumer behavior.

applicability.revision: wozt pcble2gamepad 97084db; emulated Pro, not authenticated retail hardware
applicability.scope: poc/protocol.c lines 137-144 and 205-232; poc/test-protocol.c lines 19-51, 53-92. Compatibility implementation plus deterministic test only. Related gaps swpro-l0-consumer-colour-spi-no-evidence, virtualgamepad #156 and #279.
